title: 2011 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah / Timo Gottschalk (Volkswagen) and Marc Coma (KTM)
summary: The 2011 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 14 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah / Timo Gottschalk (Volkswagen); Bikes: Marc Coma (KTM); Quads: Alejandro Patronelli (Yamaha); Trucks: Vladimir Chagin / Sergey Savostin / Ildar Shaysultanov (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
